meta.name: standup
meta.description: Facilitate a read-only standup across git worktrees, branches, or PRs to compare changes and produce one consolidation plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总多个分支或PR的变更，生成统一计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个工作分支间快速同步变更并制定合并计划
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate changes across branches or PRs into one consolidation plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly sync changes across multiple work branches and create a merge plan

howto.what: Claude 会把你选定的 git worktree、分支或 PR 拉进一个共享的 markdown 聊天室,每个扮演一个 agent 轮流发言;几轮之后产出一份归并计划并用大白话讲给你听。房间是只读的,只做决定,不提交、不合并。
howto.when: 当你想把多个 worktree、分支或 PR 的改动归并到一处时触发。原文说明至少要有两个候选:零个或一个不算 standup,它会直接告诉你并建议扩大范围。

say.text: 开个 standup,把最近 24 小时有改动的 worktree 拉进来
say.note: 它会先列出候选清单让你确认

say.text: 把这两个分支和那个 PR 放进同一个 standup 房间,商量怎么合
say.note: 各 agent 轮流发言,几轮后给出一份合并计划

say.text: 用大白话总结这次 standup:先合谁、哪些决定要我拍板
say.note: 它会翻译成人类可读的结论和待定项

howto.what_en: Claude puts the worktrees, branches, or PRs you pick into one shared markdown chat, each speaking as its own agent. After a few rounds it writes one consolidation plan and explains it to you plainly. Read-only — it decides, never merges.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to fold several worktrees, branches, or PRs into one place. The source says zero or one candidate is not a standup — Claude will say so and offer to widen the net.

say_en.text: Run a standup on every worktree touched in the last 24 hours
say_en.note: It lists the candidates for you to confirm first

say_en.text: Put these two branches and that PR in one standup room and sort out the merge
say_en.note: Each agent speaks in turn, then it delivers one plan

say_en.text: Wrap up the standup in plain words: merge order and what I must decide
say_en.note: It translates the result into human-readable choices
